manualReview.reviewer: Codex image inspection of all three generated JPEGs on 2026-11-19; not user approval
findings: San Petronio nave/aisles and palace roof portions are more distinct than plain BO-002; no visible floating roof or newly blocked square
Portico 21018 shows an L-shaped canopy on narrow columns with visible undercroft; courtyard interior remains open
Overview shows no visible tile bars; both top corner cells are intentionally outside the manifest
Palace clock tower remains generic/unverified; church facade details and measured ridges are outside this pilot
limitations: Only two verified palace portions; clock mapping and sculpture omitted
Roof uplift/topology and palette are bounded estimates; basilica height conventions unresolved
Portico 28017 rejected due OSM fallback overlap; source 21018 used without cutting baseline solids
